description: FrostIDE feature matrix, generated from PLAN.md Appendix A and Appendix C by `python tools/featurecheck.py generate`; `featurecheck.py check` (run by the verify scripts) fails when it is out of date. Hand-maintained fields: acceptance_test (the ctest name or scenario that proves the row), status (planned, in-progress, green, deferred) and inspection_counts.s9_baseline; generate preserves them. Feature row IDs are the Appendix A row numbers; infrastructure rows use the I prefix. 'milestone' owns the row; 'completes' is the milestone where its last sub-part lands (+Mx); 'epics' are the Roadmap v2 epics that deliver it (Appendix A 'Epic mapping').
source: PLAN.md Appendix A; inspection-count targets from PLAN.md section 6.1

inspection_counts.description: Spike S9 records the baseline counts of the pinned LLVM here; the M7, M9 and M13 exits gate on the targets (PLAN.md section 6.1).

s9_baseline.method: Spike S9 (PLAN.md M0): configurable warning groups from LLVM's diagnostic tables (diagtool tree, or clang-tblgen -gen-clang-diag-groups over the 23.1.x sources), primary tidy checks from `clang-tidy -checks=* --list-checks` with aliases removed, CSA checkers from `clang -cc1 -analyzer-checker-help`. Recorded by hand; featurecheck generate keeps it.

detail.clang_warning_groups: 1202 groups in `diagtool tree`; 1157 own at least one diagnostic themselves or through a group below them (the gated count); 45 are GCC-compatibility no-ops
detail.clang_tidy_checks: 602 listed by `clang-tidy -checks=* --list-checks`; 162 aliases (97 of them clang-analyzer-*); 406 primary checks outside clang-analyzer-* (the gated count)
